sections.overview: The ornate sheep tick ranges from northern Africa across Europe into Central Asia.
sections.identification: For hard ticks, adults are generally the best stage for species-level identification, which relies on diagnostic morphological characters.
sections.habitat: In southwest Germany, it is associated with sheep in warmer regions.
sections.diet: Adult ticks are frequently found on sheep in southwest Germany. Larvae and nymphs feed mainly on small mammals.
sections.behavior: Adults are active in spring, early summer and autumn.
sections.reproduction: It takes three blood meals. In warm sites, a generation may develop within one growing season.
sections.ecology: It can carry spotted-fever rickettsiae and Coxiella burnetii, the Q-fever agent.
sections.conservation: The German study discusses possible northward expansion under climate warming, not population decline.
